newsitem.title: USA: Asian exporters confident on Hong Kong future - DHL.
newsitem.headline: Asian exporters confident on Hong Kong future - DHL.

text.p: Asian exporters believe Hong Kong exports will remain level or grow after the British colony comes under Chinese control July 1, according to a quarterly export survey conducted for DHL Worldwide Express.

The Gallup Organization polled 1,125 Asian based exporters and found exporters in Hong Kong and its neighbors are most optimistic about the colony's future under Chinese rule; 75 percent of respondents in Hong Kong, China and Taiwan believe Hong Kong will not suffer an export decline.
However, further away in Singapore, 66 percent of exporters believe Hong Kong will be worse off, DHL said in a statement. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017
